results.title: Waldo by Wherobots: the AI agent for spatial data, from raw pixels to production data pipelines
results.content:
AI agents work well with text, documents, databases, and the internet. Physical-world data comes in rasters, point clouds, parcels, and road networks, and general-purpose agents get spatial relationships wrong. Waldo works across the full Wherobots stack, the AI Context Engine for Physical World Data, for data science, engineering, and production data pipelines. [...] [1:08] Every step lands on a map so you can inspect it before you trust it.
[1:16] [music]
[1:18] And it scales from one county to the whole state to the entire planet.
[1:26] The answer is measured deterministically with every table and step behind it.
[1:32] Then it ships as a pipeline that runs every week or whenever you need it. Same stack, any question from simple tasks to complex workflows.
[1:43] Waldo by Wroobots. Try it now. [...] What Waldo does in the demo:
• Searches the Wherobots open catalog, Havasu, and your proprietary data to find where to start
• Checks definitions with you before running anything: CPUC Tier 2 and Tier 3 fire-threat zones, residential parcels, and 10-minute drive times
• Builds a missing tree canopy layer: RasterFlow runs a canopy height model over aerial imagery and turns the result into polygons
